description: This file defines a ConnectionManager class that manages WebSocket connections using FastAPI, supporting connection, disconnection, and broadcasting JSON messages to clients.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A class that tracks live WebSocket connections and supports broadcasting JSON messages to all connected clients.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectionManager with an empty set of connections and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: None connect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and adds it to the set of active connections.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the active set.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Serializes a message to JSON and sends it to all active WebSocket connections.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, message: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/
